blocks.text: CAINTA, Rizal — The 28th Sta. Lucia East Tenpin Bowling Association (Sletba) Open Championships rolled off Friday at the Sta. Lucia East Bowling Center here. Members of the national team as well as players from various associations in Metro Manila and the provinces, will play in this annual tournament sanctioned by the Philippine Bowling Federation. A ceremonial roll by the presidents and representatives of the various associations capped the program ushering the event. Players participating in the week-long tournament will vie for cash prizes in eight divisions—mixed open, mixed classified, men senior associate, men senior classified, ladies classified, ladies rising stars, […]...
